1.web: At that time, Judah went down from his brothers, and visited a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.
1.asv: And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.

2.web: Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite whose name was Shua. He took her, and went in to her.
2.asv: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite whose name was Shua; and he took her, and went in unto her.

3.web: She conceived, and bore a son; and he named him Er.
3.asv: And she conceived, and bare a son; and he called his name Er.

4.web: She conceived again, and bore a son; and she named him Onan.
4.asv: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and she called his name Onan.

5.web: She yet again bore a son, and named him Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bore him.
5.asv: And she yet again bare a son, and called his name Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bare him.

6.web: Judah took a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.
6.asv: And Judah took a wife for Er his first-born, and her name was Tamar.

7.web: Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of Yahweh. Yahweh killed him.
7.asv: And Er, Judah’s first-born, was wicked in the sight of Jehovah; and Jehovah slew him.

8.web: Judah said to Onan, “Go in to your brother’s wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her, and raise up seed to your brother.”
8.asv: And Judah said unto Onan, Go in unto thy brother’s wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother unto her, and raise up seed to thy brother.

9.web: Onan knew that the seed wouldn’t be his; and when he went in to his brother’s wife, he spilled it on the ground, lest he should give seed to his brother.
9.asv: And Onan knew that the seed would not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother’s wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest he should give seed to his brother.

10.web: The thing which he did was evil in the sight of Yahweh, and he killed him also.
10.asv: And the thing which he did was evil in the sight of Jehovah: and he slew him also.

11.web: Then Judah said to Tamar, his daughter-in-law, “Remain a widow in your father’s house, until Shelah, my son, is grown up”; for he said, “Lest he also die, like his brothers.” Tamar went and lived in her father’s house.
11.asv: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter-in-law, Remain a widow in thy father’s house, till Shelah my son be grown up; for he said, Lest he also die, like his brethren. And Tamar went and dwelt in her father’s house.

12.web: After many days, Shua’s daughter, the wife of Judah, died. Judah was comforted, and went up to his sheep shearers to Timnah, he and his friend Hirah, the Adullamite.
12.asv: And in process of time Shua’s daughter, the wife of Judah, died; and Judah was comforted, and went up unto his sheep-shearers to Timnah, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.

13.web: It was told Tamar, saying, “Behold, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”
13.asv: And it was told Tamar, saying, Behold, thy father-in-law goeth up to Timnah to shear his sheep.

14.web: She took off of her the garments of her widowhood, and covered herself with her veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the gate of Enaim, which is by the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown up, and she wasn’t given to him as a wife.
14.asv: And she put off from her the garments of her widowhood, and covered herself with her veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the gate of Enaim, which is by the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown up, and she was not given unto him to wife.

15.web: When Judah saw her, he thought that she was a prostitute, for she had covered her face.
15.asv: When Judah saw her, he thought her to be a harlot; for she had covered her face.

16.web: He turned to her by the way, and said, “Please come, let me come in to you,” for he didn’t know that she was his daughter-in-law. She said, “What will you give me, that you may come in to me?”
16.asv: And he turned unto her by the way, and said, Come, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee: for he knew not that she was his daughter-in-law. And she said, What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?

17.web: He said, “I will send you a young goat from the flock.” She said, “Will you give me a pledge, until you send it?”
17.asv: And he said, I will send thee a kid of the goats from the flock. And she said, Wilt thou give me a pledge, till thou send it?

18.web: He said, “What pledge will I give you?” She said, “Your signet and your cord, and your staff that is in your hand.” He gave them to her, and came in to her, and she conceived by him.
18.asv: And he said, What pledge shall I give thee? And she said, Thy signet and thy cord, and thy staff that is in thy hand. And he gave them to her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.

19.web: She arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.
19.asv: And she arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.

20.web: Judah sent the young goat by the hand of his friend, the Adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman’s hand, but he didn’t find her.
20.asv: And Judah sent the kid of the goats by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman’s hand: but he found her not.

21.web: Then he asked the men of her place, saying, “Where is the prostitute, that was at Enaim by the road?” They said, “There has been no prostitute here.”
21.asv: Then he asked the men of her place, saying, Where is the prostitute, that was at Enaim by the wayside? And they said, There hath been no prostitute here.

22.web: He returned to Judah, and said, “I haven’t found her; and also the men of the place said, ‘There has been no prostitute here.’”
22.asv: And he returned to Judah, and said, I have not found her; and also the men of the place said, There hath been no prostitute here.

23.web: Judah said, “Let her keep it, lest we be shamed. Behold, I sent this young goat, and you haven’t found her.”
23.asv: And Judah said, Let her take it to her, lest we be put to shame: behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.

24.web: About three months later, Judah was told, “Tamar, your daughter-in-law, has played the prostitute. Moreover, behold, she is with child by prostitution.” Judah said, “Bring her out, and let her be burnt.”
24.asv: And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying, Tamar thy daughter-in-law hath played the harlot; and moreover, behold, she is with child by whoredom. And Judah said, Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.

25.web: When she was brought out, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, “By the man, whose these are, I am with child.” She also said, “Please discern whose are these—the signet, and the cords, and the staff.”
25.asv: When she was brought forth, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, By the man, whose these are, am I with child: and she said, Discern, I pray thee, whose are these, the signet, and the cords, and the staff.

26.web: Judah acknowledged them, and said, “She is more righteous than I, because I didn’t give her to Shelah, my son.” He knew her again no more.
26.asv: And Judah acknowledged them, and said, She is more righteous than I, forasmuch as I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.

27.web: In the time of her travail, behold, twins were in her womb.
27.asv: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins were in her womb.

28.web: When she travailed, one put out a hand, and the midwife took and tied a scarlet thread on his hand, saying, “This came out first.”
28.asv: And it came to pass, when she travailed, that one put out a hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first.

29.web: As he drew back his hand, behold, his brother came out, and she said, “Why have you made a breach for yourself?” Therefore his name was called Perez.
29.asv: And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said, Wherefore hast thou made a breach for thyself? therefore his name was called Perez.

30.web: Afterward his brother came out, that had the scarlet thread on his hand, and his name was called Zerah.
30.asv: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called Zerah.
